title: Fake bank fraud department: read the code and move money to a "safe account"

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is Sarah from the fraud department at Sunshine Community Bank. We stopped a suspicious charge on your account.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Someone in another state is trying to take your savings. I just sent a 6 digit code to your phone. Can you read it to me so I can verify you?

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Okay, let me look. It says 4, 8, 2...

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Perfect. Now, to protect your money, you need to move it to a new safe account we opened for you. I'll give you the account number.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please don't go to the branch. Some of the employees there might be part of the fraud.
